title: A single exceptional-component pushout on a nodal marked curve
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-field] [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $(R,L)$ and $(C,D)$ be semistable multipointed $k$-curves [def-trf-multipointed-curve] [def-trf-multipointed-curve-modification], with no properness, separatedness or connectedness assumed for their structural maps to $k$. Let $r:(R,L)\to(C,D)$ be a proper surjective morphism of pairs [def-weil-proper-morphism], whose marking map is an isomorphism. Assume all geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] of its curve map are connected [def-weil-connected-scheme]. Suppose $U\subset C$ is an open subset meeting every irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $C$ and $r^{-1}(U)\to U$ is an isomorphism. Let $A\subset R$ be an irreducible component isomorphic to $\mathbf P^1_k$ [def-sc-p1-standard], mapped by $r$ to one point, such that the boundary $\partial_R A=A\cap\overline{R\setminus A}$ is nonempty and $|A\cap(L\cup R_{\mathrm{sing}})|\le2$. The singular locus here is the set of points where $R/k$ is not smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Then the scheme pushout [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of $R\leftarrow A\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] exists. Its map $h:R\to R_1$ is proper and surjective, has connected geometric fibres, contracts precisely $A$ and is an isomorphism $R\setminus A\simeq R_1\setminus\{h(A)\}$. The scheme-theoretic image $L_1$ of $L$ (defined by the kernel of $\mathcal O_{R_1}\to h_*\mathcal O_L$) gives a semistable multipointed pair $(R_1,L_1)$ and $L\to L_1$ is an isomorphism. The factorization $r=r_1h$ induced by the pushout is a proper surjective morphism of pairs to $(C,D)$ with connected geometric curve fibres, marking map an isomorphism, and $r_1^{-1}(U)\simeq U$. The irreducible components of $R_1$ are exactly the images of the components of $R$ other than $A$, with distinct such components having distinct images.
